peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 8.1% below its local comparables; 27 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (28.7): 3.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 29 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,125,000 ($1,417 psf, 742–882 sq ft; 18 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,664 psf (range $1,348–1,771); 14.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $196,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,732,500 ($1,531 psf, 1,130–1,194 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,552 psf (range $1,365–1,663); 1.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $24,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Layar LRT about 60 m, Fernvale LRT about 480 m; closer than 114 of 116 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 10 within 2 km; nearest Fern Green Primary School about 530 m; more than 86 of 116 similar developments (the same as 18). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 510 m), more than 54 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Fernvale Hawker Centre & Market about 400 m; nearest park Sengkang Riverside Park about 300 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 22 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 616 resales (616 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (40) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 616 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 96 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 616 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 645 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.5%). Planning-area private resales −10%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
